'''''Star Wars: Lando - Double or Nothing''''' is a [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries written by [[Rodney Barnes]] with art by [[Paolo Villanelli]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[May]] [[2018]]. The limited comic series told a story that focused on the characters [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[L3-37]] just prior to ''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story]]''.<ref name="Announcement" />
